scope: Private S31 functional CPLL/DIG/RTC initialization to actual official bootloader log, not application/display or product readiness.
sources: sources.json: fixed ESP-IDF6.1 fff9895c82d744c7237be8847347bdd1b07c6643, LP/HP clock and PMU register headers, clock LL/rtc_clk.c and DIG register/route definitions.

semantics.cpll: Power/I2C/global gates + ALIVE output, actual40MHz feedback/reference, supported320MHz calibration configuration, explicit start/poll/stop.16 functional instruction quanta are a deterministic model choice, not measured settling. Completed output drives actual CPU/MEM/SYS/APB rate latch. Active CPU clock removal/recalibration/divider change is rejected before mutation.
semantics.rtc: RO XTAL40MHz; RTC_FAST selectsXTAL or power-gated nominalRC_FAST17.5MHz; RTC_SLOW nominal136kHz. No automatic CPU-to-RTC time conversion,32k crystal input,force override or sleep transitions. LL20MHz prose differs from fixed clock-tree nominal17.5MHz.
semantics.dig: Slave0x6d registers5,7,13,14 require explicit caller data, parent/master clock and routing. No guessed analog reset. Master reset preserves separate target bytes. Hardware voltage/retention uncharacterized.
semantics.irqCleanup: Known reset-disabled PMU sleep/BODmode0 IRQ enable reads0; clearing inactive events is WT. Attempts to enable missing sources fail. Existing BODmode1 qualified comparator is separate.
semantics.headerDifference: PMU high-group fields sayWT; some generated CPLL per-field aliases sayRW. Follow groupWT and actual LL tie-high/low protocol; no silicon assertion.

validation.productionScope: No production native/WASM source path changes; S31 remains a separate crate absent from CLI/WASM dependencies. Actual binary comparison and CPU/output samples retained; no native byte-identity or S31 performance claim.

reproduce.officialProbe: cargo build --release -p esp32s31 --example bringup; python3 tools/s31-native-firmware-probe.py --firmware-url <caller-URL> --sha256 <caller-SHA256> --rom <public20260528-S31-ROM-ELF> --rom-spi0-shadow --nor-jedec ef4018 --analog-bias 0000 --analog-perif-glitch ff --analog-dig ffffffff --steps 2000000 --output <receipt.json>
